registration_scope: Locally fixed stage-two exploratory protocol, not a public preregistration or confirmation of novelty

classification.unit: exact-duplicate-collapsed source rows; unknown physical specimen/batch groups
classification.outer_split: 5-fold stratified, seed20261030, freeze before inspecting model scores
classification.inner_split: train-only 3-fold, identical within each outer fold across models
classification.retained_features_mcuve: ceil(0.1p), at least5, same across MCUVE20/100/stable
classification.success_assessment: Report all outer predictions, accuracy/balanced accuracy/macroF1/MCC, feature counts and time; no automatic deployment winner chosen from these test scores
caveats: Huangqi Raman and UV same cohort
exact duplicates collapsed; near-replicate IDs unavailable
stability frequency/Jaccard are training diagnostics, not out-of-batch robustness or FDR control

datasets: Pharma instrument1 supplied Train+Validate to instrument2 supplied Test
transfer.source_model: PLS; source-only raw/SNV and1,2,3,5,8 components inner3fold selection
transfer.query_policy: Each repeat fixes query after reserving maxshots20 target records; nested firstk support, same query for all k and methods
transfer.uncertainty: repeat SD is descriptive; repeated query sets overlap and are not independent studies
caveats: Recovered record/positional IDs are limited by source documentation
WheatA and B use same150 new-sample targets, not independent cohorts
Pharma assay mg/tablet; wheat response units not independently verified

deliverables: audited source catalog with availability tiers
actual positive and negative benchmark results
novelty: Prior-art EMCUVE voting and SAFS+calibration already exist; module combination alone is not a new algorithm
